rec-e1.subject: Sikugcinele indawo yakho kwi-Gadit
rec-e1.body:
Molo {name},

Uqalile ukubhalisela i-{plan}, wema phambi nje kokuba ugqibe.

Sikugcinele yonke into, kwaye ungaqhubeka kanye apho ume khona.

- Iintsuku ezili-14 simahla, kwaye akukho nto ihlawuliswayo namhlanje
- Emva kovavanyo: {price}
- Siza kukuthumelela isikhumbuzo nge-imeyile phambi kokuba uvavanyo luphele
- Unokurhoxisa nanini na kwiphepha lakho leakhawunti, ngokucofa kabini
rec-e1.next: Ikhona into engacacanga? Phendula nje le imeyile, siza kukunceda.

rec-e2-family.subject: Oko abantwana bakho bakufumanayo kwi-Gadit
rec-e2-family.body:
Molo {name},

Besifuna ukukuxelela ngokufutshane into elindele abantwana bakho kwi-Gadit:

Igama ngalinye abadibana nalo, encwadini, kumsebenzi wasekhaya okanye encokolweni, liba ligama abaliqonda ngokwenene.

- Inkcazelo ekwinqanaba lomntwana wakho, enomfanekiso kwintsingiselo nganye
- Imidlalo nokuziqhelisa okwenziwe ngamagama abo
- Uncedo kumsebenzi wasekhaya
- Ibhodi yomzali ekubonisa inkqubela yomntwana ngamnye

Ukubhalisa kwakho kwi-{plan} kugciniwe, kwaye kusele inyathelo lokugqibela kuphela.
rec-e2-family.next: Akukho nto ihlawuliswayo namhlanje, kwaye ungarhoxisa nanini na kwiphepha lakho leakhawunti.

rec-e2-indiv.subject: Oko kukulindeleyo kwi-Gadit
rec-e2-indiv.body:
Molo {name},

Besifuna ukukuxelela ngokufutshane into ekulindeleyo kwi-Gadit:

Igama ngalinye, encwadini, emsebenzini okanye encokolweni, liba ligama oliqonda ngokupheleleyo.

- Zonke iintsingiselo zegama, ngomfanekiso kwintsingiselo nganye
- Imidlalo nokuziqhelisa okwenziwe ngamagama akho
- Incwadi yakho yamagama egcina yonke into oyifundileyo

Ukubhalisa kwakho kwi-{plan} kugciniwe, kwaye kusele inyathelo lokugqibela kuphela.
rec-e2-indiv.next: Akukho nto ihlawuliswayo namhlanje, kwaye ungarhoxisa nanini na kwiphepha lakho leakhawunti.

rec-e3.subject: Ingaba ikhona into ekuthintileyo? Sixelele
rec-e3.body:
Molo {name},

Ukubhalisa kwakho kwi-{plan} kusagciniwe.

Ukuba ikhona into ekubambezelayo, phendula nje le imeyile, siza kukunceda.

act-first-word-family.subject: Igama lokuqala labantwana bakho kwi-Gadit
act-first-word-family.body:
Molo {name},

Eyona ndlela ilungileyo yokuqalisa: hlala nomntwana wakho imizuzu emihlanu, nikhangele igama elinye adibene nalo namhlanje, encwadini, kumsebenzi wasekhaya okanye encokolweni.

- Chwetheza igama kwindawo yokukhangela
- Bona inkcazelo ekwinqanaba lomntwana wakho, enomfanekiso kwintsingiselo nganye
- Ligcine encwadini yamagama, kwaye ukusukela apho lingena kwimidlalo yakhe

Igama elinye namhlanje, kwaye umntwana wakho sele eqalisa ukwakha isigama sakhe.
act-first-word-family.next: Ufuna uncedo? Phendula nje le imeyile.

act-first-word-indiv.subject: Igama lakho lokuqala kwi-Gadit
act-first-word-indiv.body:
Molo {name},

Eyona ndlela ilungileyo yokuqalisa: khangela igama elinye odibene nalo namhlanje, encwadini, emsebenzini okanye encokolweni.

- Zonke iintsingiselo zalo, ngomfanekiso kwintsingiselo nganye
- Apho igama livela khona
- Ligcine encwadini yakho yamagama uze uziqhelise ngalo kwimidlalo emifutshane

Igama elinye namhlanje, kwaye isigama sakho sele sikhula.
act-first-word-indiv.next: Ufuna uncedo? Phendula nje le imeyile.

act-first-word-2.subject: Igama elinye, imizuzu emihlanu
act-first-word-2.body:
Molo {name},

Ingcamango encinci yanamhlanje: khetha igama elinye encwadini, kumsebenzi wasekhaya okanye kwiindaba, uze ulikhangele kwi-Gadit.

Kumzuzu nje ubona zonke iintsingiselo zalo, ngomfanekiso nemizekelo, kwaye ligcinwa encwadini yamagama ukuze uziqhelise.

Yiyo le ndlela isigama esikhula ngayo: igama elinye ngexesha.
act-first-word-2.next: Ufuna uncedo? Phendula nje le imeyile.

act-add-child.subject: Elinye inyathelo: yongeza umntwana wakho
act-add-child.body:
Molo {name},

I-Gadit Family yakhelwe abantwana bakho, kodwa akukabikho mntwana wongeziweyo kwiakhawunti. Kuthatha umzuzu:

- Chwetheza igama lomntwana wakho uze ukhethe umlinganiswa
- Dibanisa isixhobo sakhe ngaphandle kwephasiwedi, okanye usebenzise iMo yabantwana kwisixhobo sakho
- Ukusukela ngoko igama ngalinye alikhangelayo liyagcinwa, kwaye ubona inkqubela kwibhodi yomzali
act-add-child.next: Ufuna uncedo? Phendula nje le imeyile.

act-return-family.subject: Isiqalo esifutshane kwi-Gadit, esenzelwe wena
act-return-family.body:
Molo {name},

Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuba abantwana bakho bafumana yonke into i-Gadit enokubanika yona. Nanga amanyathelo amathathu amafutshane okuqalisa kule veki:

- Yongeza umntwana kwiakhawunti, ukuba awukakwenzi (umzuzu omnye)
- Khangelani kunye igama elinye encwadini okanye kumsebenzi wasekhaya
- Vula imidlalo, eyenziwe ngamagama agcinwe ngumntwana wakho
act-return-family.next: Ufuna sikubonise ukuba isebenza njani? Phendula le imeyile, kwaye siza kulungiselela umnxeba omfutshane wemizuzu eli-10.

act-return-indiv.subject: Isiqalo esifutshane kwi-Gadit, esenzelwe wena
act-return-indiv.body:
Molo {name},

Sifuna ukuqinisekisa ukuba ufumana yonke into i-Gadit enokukunika yona. Nanga amanyathelo amathathu amafutshane okuqalisa kule veki:

- Khangela igama elinye odibene nalo namhlanje
- Ligcine encwadini yakho yamagama
- Ziqhelise amagama akho kwimidlalo emifutshane
act-return-indiv.next: Ufuna sikubonise ukuba isebenza njani? Phendula le imeyile, kwaye siza kulungiselela umnxeba omfutshane wemizuzu eli-10.
